#### Ingredient problems:

+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
|                       | **Drug**                                | **Purpose**                  | **Problem**                                          |
+=======================+=========================================+==============================+======================================================+
| Sodium metabisulfite  | Lignocaine, adrenaline                  | Anti-oxidant, anti-microbial | - Anaphylaxis                                        |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Egg lecithin          | Propofol                                | Emulsifier                   | - ?Anaphylaxis                                       |
|                       |                                         |                              | - Protein deplete; theoretical risk                  |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Benzethonium chloride | Ketamine                                | Antimicrobial                | - ?Neurotoxicity                                     |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Propylene glycol      | Etomidate, diazepam, digoxin, phenytoin | Solubiliser                  | - Pain on injection                                  |
|                       |                                         |                              | - Thrombophlebitis                                   |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Soybean oil           | Propofol                                | Solubiliser                  | - Lipotoxicity                                       |
|                       |                                         |                              | - Bacterial contamination risk                       |
|                       |                                         |                              | - Propofol infusion syndrome                         |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Mannitol              | Paracetamol                             | Tonicity                     | - Osmotic diuresis                                   |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Glycine               | Remifentanil                            | Bulk agent                   | - Neurotoxic (not for intrathecal use)               |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| ↑pH, ↑concentration   | Thiopentone                             |                              | - Precipitation if intra-arterial injection          |
|                       |                                         |                              | - Necrosis if extravasation                          |
|                       |                                         |                              | - Precipitation with acidic drugs e.g. suxamethonium |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------+
